title: Deploy a scanner
description: Install a lightweight daemon on any network segment. It discovers hosts, services, subnets, switches, and workloads.

title: Four views generate automatically
description: Physical (L2), Logical (L3), Workloads, and Applications. All from one scan.

title: Stays accurate on a schedule
description: Rescans on your cadence, so the model never goes stale.

title: Four views of your infrastructure
description: Network architecture, service dependencies, workload placement, and physical topology, each answering a different question about your infrastructure.

title: See every service at a glance
description: The topology shows {{SERVICE_COUNT}} detected services - Docker, PostgreSQL, nginx, and more - right in the visualization.

title: Composable grouping
description: Organize by VLAN, application group, workload hierarchy, or custom tags. Stack grouping rules to build the view you need.

title: Version history
description: Create branches, lock versions, and compare network state over time.

title: Share, export, embed
description: Send live view links, export diagrams, or embed maps anywhere.
